public.app-category.utilities
Dynamai uses Automation to move files, send items to the Trash, open requested commands and control playback in your media apps. SIRI also uses it to read, write and send email in Mail when you ask.
Dynamai uses each app's audio to adjust its volume in the mixer, to move Dynamic Island's music bars and to include the Mac's sound in the screen recordings you start. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Dynamai uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.

Dynamai records your microphone only when you turn it on for a screen recording. The audio stays on your Mac unless you choose to create a temporary link. It also listens while you dictate a message to VERTUS in Dynamic Island.
Dynamai turns what you say into text only while you dictate a message to VERTUS in Dynamic Island. Recognition runs on this Mac when it supports it; otherwise Apple processes the audio.
Show your upcoming appointments in the notch. Calendar events stay on this Mac.
Dynamai shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Dynamai checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
Dynamai organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads in a destination folder you explicitly choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
